about_the_game:
Bakahazard 3 is the sequel of Bakahazard 1+2.

With the protagonist nearly escaped from death (?), he and his classmates from Breakfast High School have found themselves on another bizarre adventure!

Turn-based combat, more evolved than ever! More skills to throw on enemies! More buffs to stack! Stronger allies! And... rumor has it that Earth just updated with a new 'Resistance' system—the lower your resistance, the faster your HP drops? Should've known all that pay-to-win cash was spent on buffing the enemies instead!

Scouring a snow mountain for hot springs... Battling RGB-lit tanks in a fictional urban warzone... Taking down a bizarre cult on a remote island... Bakahazard 3 delivers an even more thrilling, hilarious, and pulse-pounding adventure than Bakahazard 1+2!

FEATURES

An enhanced turn-based RPG battle system, still old-school.

A richer story! Maybe even a little mind-bending? And of course, packed with witty and hilarious dialogue!

Approximately 10 hours of tight, linear storytelling.

A boy but looks like a girl.

A boy but looks... not that much like a girl.

Spend the rest of your days snuggled in your cozy little bed at home.

...or just beat up the very same bed that's been waiting for your return.

content_descriptors.notes: Includes some violence content or strong language.

name: Bakahazard 3

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 580 or NVIDIA GTX 750ti, Intel HD 530 for minimum integrated graphics card.
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: HD Audio
  • Additional Notes: These are the minimum specs the dev team can find and test. Actual performance may vary depend on your system. Most hardware from 2016 onward should run it fine. Lower-end systems may experience problems. Disk I/O issues could also impact gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5-12500H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: HD Audio
  • Additional Notes: These are the dev team's own specs that ensure normal game function, you may not need hardware this powerful to run the game.
